notes: Jamaica OCJ (Ian Fleming, Boscobel) cut, 2026-11-10. No licensed OCJ landing or terminal footage exists (YouTube CC BY, Pexels, Pixabay searched); opening uses north-coast approach footage (gcm2xnh129E, St James coast) labelled as such; narration says 'flying into Jamaica's north coast'. Clips reused from the MBJ library (same licence evidence, pool/jamaica/licence) plus Rk2IRGPukWw (DroneR JA, Ocho Rios) and taA4JUAfdOQ (Driving Time, Rio Nuevo/Boscobel).
